description: This file implements streak calculation logic for a habit and task tracker, specifically focusing on daily streaks based on completed dates. It exports a function to compute current and best streaks given an array of completion dates and optional reference date.

methods.name: calculateDailyStreaks
methods.description: Calculates the current and best streaks of completed days based on an array of ISO date strings and an optional reference date (defaults to today). It processes the dates to determine consecutive streaks, handling edge cases like missing days and duplicate dates.
